status: Closed — pre-commit now reports foreign generated residue without mutating it; source and frozen runner verified; formal backlog closeout recorded 2026-09-05
finding: A pre-commit invocation with no staged files auto-removed generated bundle manifests belonging to previously released tasks. The cleanup is observable but is outside the current candidate and can mutate a shared worktree during an otherwise read/validate operation.
expectedBehavior: Automatic cleanup must be candidate- or explicitly-owned-scope bounded. Cross-task generated residue should be reported as a separately actionable cleanup batch, not silently mutated by an unrelated hook invocation. Any cleanup write must carry an owner, receipt, and exact-path attribution.
evidenceOrRepro: 2026-08-14 source-first node atm.dev.mjs hook pre-commit --json after commit 7e7573c5149a2f83e84b9424aee2ea4c00216718 passed in 4314 ms with stagedFileCount 0, while reporting ATM_HOOK_AUTO_CLEANED_GENERATED_RESIDUE for 22 released-task bundle-manifest files. Commit bfbdf894f changed pre-commit to an admission observer: it classifies but does not delete generated residue. 2026-09-02 regression packages/cli/src/commands/hook/__tests__/pre-commit.spec.ts passed and proves a released foreign bundle-manifest survives a hook run; current frozen packages/cli/dist/commands/hook/pre-commit/implementation.js contains the same no-mutation implementation.
followUp: Use an explicit, task-owned cleanup command or bounded post-transaction finalizer when a released bundle-manifest must be removed. Preserve the fast hook budget by reporting candidates without writes; do not reintroduce hook-side deletion.
